[cols="3,2,2,5",options="header"]
|===
|Path |Type |Default |Description

|`pass:c[spec.apiVersion]`
|string
|
|ApiVersion is the claim's apiVersion ("group/version"). Required together with Kind when the Action lives in a claim namespace.

|`pass:c[spec.args]`
|map[string]string
|
|Args are made available to the job. Stored, not injected for now.

|`pass:c[spec.claim]`
|string
|
|Claim identifies the service instance; with ApiVersion and Kind it derives the instance namespace when the Action lives in a claim namespace.

|`pass:c[spec.kind]`
|string
|
|Kind is the claim's kind. Required together with ApiVersion when the Action lives in a claim namespace.

|`pass:c[spec.type]` *(required)*
|string
|
|Type names the Definition (in the instance namespace) to execute. +
_Validation:_ min length 1
|===
